The [mapoli](index.html) Legislative District Atlas was created by
Brent Benson who has a passion for collecting, combining, and
analyzing data, with a particular interest in Massachusetts politics
and policy. You can get in touch with Brent on
[Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/brentwbenson.org),
[Threads](https://www.threads.com/@bwbensonjr), or by email
using the address `brent` at `mapoli.us`.

The primary sources for the data in the district atlas are:

- Election results data from the invaluable
  [electionstats.state.ma.us](https://electionstats.state.ma.us/) site
  created by [Adam Friedman of Civera](https://civera.com/team/) and
  supported by the [Secretary of the
  Commonwealth](https://www.sec.state.ma.us/).
- GIS mapping and geometry data from
  (MassGIS)(https://www.mass.gov/orgs/massgis-bureau-of-geographic-information).
- Demographic data from [U.S. Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/).
